title: Nine Stops of Rain
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：bus　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bus 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to catch ① a bus she could not see, and she said the seeing was the whole of the lesson. The ② bus, meaning the vehicle and not the route, was nine stops away and was waited for by whoever came last; a bus, she said, is the only thing on a road that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bus in that depot had the same number, and the ④ bus at the end, meaning the one the driver kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cleaned properly. A bus, my grandmother said, is nine parts diesel and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the diesel is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bus was the whole of the journey, meaning the ride it gave and not the vehicle. The ⑥ bus, meaning the journey and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody waits for and nobody questions; a bus, he said, is either something you catch or the only word that means both a vehicle and a journey. She said the journey is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ bus had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the diesel. The ⑧ bus of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine stops and eleven years of waiting; a bus, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bus I remember is the one at the end, which was retired in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bus, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being waited for; every bus, she said, is a journey that has agreed to look like a vehicle. She said the journey was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 公共汽车；巴士
B. n. 公交车（指那辆车本身，与线路相对）
C. 固定搭配：catch a bus 赶上公交车
D. n. 公交车（指车场里每一辆）
E. n. 公交车（指末尾那一辆）
F. n. 公交车（抽象：它给出的那段行程）
G. n. 那段行程（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bus she could not see
The bus, meaning the vehicle and not the route
bus was the whole of the journey
the bus had become a photograph in a report
The bus of the whole thing
A bus, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: catch a bus 意为“赶上公交车”，1954 年母亲被派去赶一班她看不见的公交车。
bus 意为“公交车”，指那辆车本身而不是线路，隔九站路，由最后来的人等着。
bus 指车场里每一辆公交车，每一辆都是同样的车号。
bus 指末尾那一辆（司机开的那辆），是唯一有人认真打扫过的。
bus 意为“公交车”，抽象指它给出的那段行程，父亲说 bus 就是那趟旅程的全部。
bus 为抽象用法，指那段行程本身，是镇上人人都等、却没人质疑的东西。
bus 意为“公共汽车、巴士”，到 1969 年这辆 bus 成了报告里的一张照片。
bus 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九站路和十一年的等待。
bus 意为“公交车”，我记得的是末尾那一辆，1974 年退役，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bus 为抽象总称，祖母说公交车是唯一会因为有人肯等而变好的东西。
